name: Opening: Júlio Duarte: Viagem a Itália
description: Serralves unveils a new photography exhibition capturing António Júlio Duarte's journey through Italy.
longDescription:
Serralves Museum presents "Viagem a Itália," an exhibition of new photographic works by António Júlio Duarte. This collection documents Duarte's travels across Italy, offering a visual narrative of his observations and encounters within the country. The exhibition explores themes of landscape, architecture, and daily life through his distinctive lens, marking a significant new body of work from the acclaimed Portuguese photographer.

Visitors to Serralves will encounter a series of photographs displayed within the museum's contemporary galleries. The exhibition offers a contemplative experience, inviting viewers to engage with Duarte's perspective on Italian culture and geography. The grand setting of Serralves provides a suitable backdrop for the scale and artistic intent of the works.

The exhibition opens on June 20, 2026, at Serralves Museum. General admission tickets for the museum grant access to the exhibition. Serralves is located in western Porto and can be reached by bus lines 201, 203, 207, and 504. Limited on-site parking is also available.
